records.title: Safety of Altitude Chamber Training Operations in the Italian Air Force Experience
records.journal: International Review of the Armed Forces Medical Services
records.evidence_note: Tables 1 and 2 describe 344 exposures by ten instructors over 171 sessions. The ASEM companion report says the staff reported no incidents, excludes them from analysis and raises possible underreporting. The ICMM body and Table 3 give one Type I DCS case among 1,254 trainees and 19 ear barotraumas. The French abstract prints 1,245 trainees. Both abstracts print nine barotraumas. The companion ASEM report evaluates 1,241 trainees and describes the same DCS case. The ICMM Results say trainees who were initially not cleared completed training later and were included. A person-level crosswalk is unavailable.

observations.note: These are repeated exposures across ten instructors. The companion ASEM report is the source for zero reported incidents. Comparable ascertainment and follow-up for staff are unresolved.

observations.locator: Results and Tables 1–2, p. 15, and Table 3 and footnote, p. 16
observations.note: This is the same reported Type I DCS event as the ASEM article. The ICMM report includes initially deferred trainees who completed training later. The ASEM report gives 1,241 evaluable trainees. Use one trainee risk set if adjudicated for synthesis.
